profile.summary: My distinguishing strength as a software engineer is an ability to rethink conventional problems to arrive at new perspectives and insights. Using the mediums of abstraction and source code, I design and implement APIs, tools, and systems with cohesive models that bring these perspectives to a broader solution space with less complexity overall, especially as systems and their problem spaces evolve.
